assessment_objectives.objective: the circumstances and/or usage conditions to be enforced for users and/or roles are defined.
the users and/or roles subject to enforcement of circumstances and/or usage conditions are defined.
the defined circumstances and/or usage conditions for users and/or roles are automatically enforced through Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) policy-driven, dynamic authorizations.
Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) is enforced for policy-driven, dynamic authorizations that support the secure sharing of information.
